contract.workingSetBinding: candidate stores and verifies the complete stream_resolution and stream_root; only active chunk ids may be lowered

positiveEvidence: Region and every source chunk are verified before lowering.
Chunk mesh row-major y samples are extracted without copying or reimplementing Large World terrain generation.
Chunk origin, region/world roots, stream root, source mesh root, state root and content root remain explicit bindings.
The adapter is integration-only; Large World Runtime has no dependency on RSR.
Existing Kernel materialization produces static heightfield bodies, and existing RSR executes terrain contact and deterministic replay.
Existing VSR projection receives the same heightfield fixture mesh and a verified CPU reference frame.
Adjacent chunk shared boundary samples remain equal after lowering.
negativeEvidence: The adapter does not mutate Large World activeChunkIds or canonical state.
An inactive or region-mismatched chunk is rejected before lowering.
Tampering with height samples invalidates the batch/candidate roots.
There is no chunk-transition body lifecycle or physical terrain residency manager yet.
RSR heightfield remains a bounded single-support/AABB candidate; exact terrain ray/shape cast and full contact manifold remain open.
No dynamic terrain deformation, physical device performance, target GPU matrix, distributed physics or production release evidence exists.
nextCandidate: Bind stream enter/exit and replay to an explicit RSR terrain-body residency transition without mutating canonical world truth or duplicating terrain generation.
